_comment: Manual protected zones for mindcraft-mcgavin. Entries in `structures` become bot.protectedZones at agent startup via loadPlayerStructures(). Each entry requires: name (string), x (number, XZ center), z (number), radius (number). Optional: yMin, yMax (number; omit for full-column protection). Delete this file or leave `structures` empty to protect nothing manually; auto-detected villages are registered separately.
